quests.title: Travelers' Tales: Destiny Drawn

dialogue.t: Yes, that'll do. Just a quick and simple cleanup job...
Ah, little one, you're just in time.

dialogue.sit: Just in time... In time for what?
Hold on a second... Where's this going?

dialogue.t: Oh, look at you. I can tell you're thinking. "Oh no, she's going to send me off on some pain-in-the-neck errand again, isn't she?"
Don't worry, I was just going to say that we've finished renovating the shrine and are preparing to roll out a brand-new service.
Now, I haven't had the chance to announce it yet, but here you are already. Wouldn't you agree that's good timing?
See this offering box beside me? There's going to be another place to make wishes here soon.

dialogue.sit: Don't you already have fortune slips?

dialogue.t: That's different. Fortune slips are about telling fortunes, whereas this... is about making wishes.
Now then, close your eyes, make a wish, write it down on a prayer plaque, then hang it up on this rack here, and maybe your wish will come true.
Of course. But as for which wishes come true... That is up to the gods who watch over us all.
Powerless Guuji that I am, I can only help you in mortal matters.

dialogue.sit: I wouldn't mind making some new friends...
I'd like to be reunited with some old friends...

dialogue.t: If that's what you wish for, then why not try it out? Here, take this fortune paper.
It's left over from writing fortune slips. You can have it.
Try writing your wish there. That might make it more likely to come true.
When have I ever lied to you? Hurry up now, little one, it's time to make your wish.
Remember to write your wish on the fortune paper, then stick it to the prayer plaque and hang it on the rack...
After that, your wish will be made.
Yes. Nice and solemn. Very good.
Alright, little one, back to business with you. Remember to keep your ears pricked and your eyes open!
After all, the person you wish to meet might just be sitting at some noodle stand, having themselves a lovely bowl... And bring me back one while you're at it.

quests.description: Something new seems to be happening at the Grand Narukami Shrine…
